text:
marco: FYI opened a docs PR for cross-region deployment examples. Need reviewer and preview is timing out on the build. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/913

anya: I can take a look in ~20m. Quick question: did you include the new VPC step under 'networking'?

marco: yes added an extra step and an example config snippet. Might be hitting a flaky CDN fetch in build.

ci-bot: docs-preview triggered by marco. Build stuck at fetching remote asset: https://assets.company-cdn.com/vpc-diagram.svg (timeout)

rachel: We had a similar CDN issue last week; workaround was to vendor the svg into /static/diagrams or inline the SVG. If you want I can push a small commit.

marco: Vendoring sounds good. If you push it please add me as reviewer so I can confirm display in preview.

rachel: pushed vendor commit and updated path in the markdown. Re-run requested: /run docs-preview

ci-bot: Re-run queued by rachel. Starting docs-preview...

ci-bot: docs-preview build succeeded. Link-checker: no broken links. Accessibility check: minor contrast issue in code block background (non-blocking).

anya: Looks good to me for accuracy. Two tiny wording suggestions in the example config but non-blocking.

tyler: Quick note on ownership: docs review rotation list shows low coverage for infra-migration this sprint. Can we nominate a backup reviewer for infra-related docs?

marco: Good call. Would appreciate a rotation nominee so future PRs don't stall.

rachel: I can take point for infra-migration docs this sprint, with anya as backup. I'll add a note to the docs-owners board.

ci-bot: rachel added a comment to the owners board: "Infra-migration: rachel (primary), anya (backup)"

anya: Approved on content. Leaving a tiny nit suggestion inline.

marco: Thanks all. Merging now.

ci-bot: Merge complete. Preview link: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/913

tyler: Thanks rachel for stepping up. I'll update the rotation calendar and ping in tomorrows docs sync.

rachel: No problem. If anything unexpected pops up after merge ping me.

marco: All good on my end, closing this thread.
